loading.title: Just a Moment, Naura's Thinking~ 💭
loading.body: Hang on a little, Naura's getting everything ready for you~ ✨

success.title: Yaay, All Done! 🎀
success.body: It worked! Everything is all set for you~ ✨

error.title: Sorry, Naura Couldn't Do It 💧
error.body:
I'm really sorry, Naura couldn't pull that off. Here's what went wrong: **{reason}**
Let's try once more, okay? Naura will stay with you until it works 💕

npc.list_desc: You look around **{location}** in the {timeOfDay}. There are {count} locals who seem happy to chat~
npc.empty: You look around **{location}**... it's so quiet. Nobody is here to talk to yet.
npc.ai_fallback: Hello! Is there anything I can help you with?
npc.greet_body:
You have a relaxed chat with **{name}**. The mood is lovely and warm~
> Affection **+{bonus}**
npc.greet_cooldown: You two just had a long talk. Give **{name}** a little breathing room and come back soon~
npc.gift_body:
You buy a lovely gift for **{name}**. Their face lights up!
> Balance reduced by **{cost}**
> Affection **+{bonus}**
npc.gift_limit: **{name}** has already received {max} gifts from you today. Save the rest for tomorrow~
npc.gift_poor: You don't have enough for a proper gift yet (need **{cost}**).
npc.marry_body:
Under a beautiful sky, you offer the ring to **{name}**.

"Of course... I'd love to spend my life with you."

Congratulations! You are now married to **{name}**.
npc.marry_no_ring: You don't have a **Wedding Ring** yet! Look for one at the Gold Shop or from the Merchant.
npc.marry_not_ready: Their heart isn't fully yours yet. Get a little closer to **{name}** before proposing~
npc.marry_wrong_type: **{name}** treasures you as a dear friend, but not in that way~
npc.cutscene_unlocked: **Cutscene Unlocked!** You can relive this moment anytime with `/survival gallery`.
npc.repair_body:
**{name}:** "All done! Your axe, pickaxe, and fishing rod are back to 100%!"
> Balance reduced by **{cost}**
npc.repair_poor: You can't afford the service yet (need **{cost}**).
npc.tax_clean: **{name}:** "Your record is clean. No outstanding property tax."
npc.tax_paid:
**{name}:** "Good. Your tax is settled and your property is legal again."
> Balance reduced by **{cost}**
npc.tax_poor: You can't cover the tax yet (need **{cost}**).
npc.session_expired: The conversation has ended. Call `/survival npc` again whenever you'd like to say hello~
